description:
**Exact small symmetric TSP with a 1-tree certificate and subset fallback.** Use nonnegative integer symmetric costs and at most 12 vertices. 2-opt initialized by nearest neighbor supplies a feasible upper bound.

Compute lower bounds with minimum 1-trees and update vertex weights from degree deficits or excesses. If a lower bound matches the upper bound, return the tour with a certificate. Otherwise invoke Held–Karp subset dynamic programming and return the exact tour.

The staged certificate can avoid subset enumeration on some inputs. This adaptation combines the weighted 1-tree and the existing complete subset dynamic program. It uses integer arithmetic for the certificate comparison.
